subject: Next steps & blockers for Olive & Co trial setup
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Rivers <tom@oliveco.com>, Elena Martins <elena.martins@oliveco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: trial kickoff items + who owns what

Hi Tom / Elena —

Thanks again for hopping on the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed owners/timeframes so we don't lose momentum: 

- Action: Provide sample dataset (PII redacted) for model validation — owner: Olive & Co (Elena) — target: 6/4
- Action: Accept trial SOW and access request doc — owner: Tom — target: 6/5
- Action: Network & firewall checklist from your infra team — owner: Olive infra — target: 6/7
- Redwood: we'll provision a 2-node dedicated trial environment and share credentials; target: 6/3

Attachments: MVP_Kickoff_SOW.pdf (SOW + trial terms), redwood-trial-checklist.xlsx (network + account steps).

If anything above looks off hit reply with edits. If the dates look aggressive we can relax — just trying to align so the POC can actually run this month.

Next step from my side: if I don't hear back by Friday 6/4 I'll check in on blockers.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri...@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0199

-----Original Meeting Notes (brief):
Call: Olive & Co - trial requirements, success metrics (latency under 300ms for 99th pct), dataset size ~150k rows, security: SOC2 in progress.

---

From: Tom Rivers <tom@oliveco.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: trial kickoff items + who owns what

Hi Priyom —

Appreciate the recap. Quick update: legal is flagging an extra review step on the trial SOW (tracking data residency language). I'll need to loop Legal and Procurement; that will likely push acceptance past your target date.

We also discovered our infra team is short-staffed this week and may not complete the firewall rules until 6/11. Elena is pulling the sample dataset but wants to run a final scrub before sending.

Two questions: 1) Is there any flexibility on how long we hold the provisioned environment if we accept later in June? 2) Would Redwood be open to a slightly smaller initial dataset so we can run a narrow validation while Legal finishes?

Best,
Tom
Director of Engineering | Olive & Co

---

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Rivers <tom@oliveco.com>, Elena Martins <elena.martins@oliveco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@avery.johnson.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: trial kickoff items + who owns what

Thanks for the update Tom — that's helpful context. Short answers: 

1) Flexibility: yes. We can hold provisioning for up to 21 days from the originally scheduled start without additional cost, and we can extend that in short increments if needed.
2) Smaller dataset: absolutely — a 10% sample or a schema-equivalent subset works fine for validation and will let you prove latency/quality quickly.

If helpful I can loop Marissa from CS to offer a lightweight validation plan (3 tests: latency, correctness on 200 examples, basic throughput) to run while legal/procurement finish. Marissa — can you draft a 1-page test plan and a recommended subset size for Tom's team?

I'll hold off on provisioning until I see a confirmation from you.

Thanks,
Priyom

To: Tom Rivers <tom@oliveco.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: trial kickoff items + who owns what

Hi Tom —

Quick intro, I'm Marissa on Customer Success. Priyom asked me to put together a short validation checklist you can run with a smaller dataset. Attached is a one-pager and a sample Postman collection to hit the trial endpoint once you have creds.

If you'd rather, I'm happy to host a 30-minute hands-on session with your infra/dev on Thu 6/10 or Mon 6/14 to walk through the checklist and network steps. Which works best for you?

Attachment stub: Trial_Validation_1pager.pdf, Olive_postman_collection.json

Cheers,
Marissa Cole

marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Rivers <tom@oliveco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Checking priority — can we unblock the Olive & Co trial?

Tom —

Wanted to check in quickly since I haven't seen confirmation on acceptance or infra readiness. I know legal/procurement timelines can be unpredictable; if the trial is lower priority for June we can: 

- Pause on provisioning and re-schedule for early July, or
- Provision a minimal sandbox now (single node, 2-day window) to let Elena and your team sanity-check the flow without a full trial, or
- Keep the current plan and I can escalate on our end to reserve capacity if you confirm acceptance by 6/16.

If you prefer, we don't need a long reply — just respond with one of: "Pause", "Sandbox", or "Go" and we'll act immediately.

Thanks again — happy to jump on a short call if that helps.

Best,
Priyom
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
phone: +1 415-555-0199
